description: Estimates monthly and annual licence cost for one or more Google Workspace or Microsoft 365 SKUs in a given country, using that country's list price (prices differ by market), plus the Vietnis price and a VND conversion.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 market, e.g. VN, US

sku.description: SKU id from list_cloud_offerings, e.g. google-workspace-business-standard (names like "Business Standard" also work)

name: estimate_saas_cost
title: Estimate Google Workspace / Microsoft 365 cost
